from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

# Define correct qubit/clbit dimensions based on the user request
qc = QuantumCircuit(5, 4)

# Apply H gate to qubits 0,1,2,3
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.h(2)
qc.h(3)

# Apply X gate then H gate to ancilla qubit 4
qc.x(4)
qc.h(4)

# Apply CNOT gates
qc.cx(0, 4)
qc.cx(1, 4)
qc.cx(3, 4)

# Apply H gate again to qubits 0,1,2,3
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.h(2)
qc.h(3)

# Measure ONLY input qubits 0,1,2,3
qc.measure([0, 1, 2, 3], [0, 1, 2, 3])
